literal: Does it not yield, town known scandal? That without obtaining, having obtained like nature it has.
translation: Does not this scandal known to the whole town bring me joy? It has the nature of making me feel as if I have attained him, even when I have not.
modern: ஊர் முழுவதும் அறிந்த இந்த வதந்தி எனக்கு இன்பம் தராதா? அவரை நான் அடையாமலேயே அடைந்தது போன்ற உணர்வை அது தருகிறது.
explanation: The heroine speaks about the public gossip surrounding her relationship with her lover. She asks rhetorically if this scandal does not actually bring her joy. Because their love is now spoken of by everyone, she feels a sense of union with him. The gossip creates the illusion of having attained him, even when they are physically apart.
